summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'Get Noticed Faster' ₹499 feature. Dashboard button, Matches-tab gate, referral auto-unlock and ₹499 mock-pay were verified end-to-end via real login flow using +919746835595 and +919555000111. CRITICAL: ChatFlow done-panel still renders the OLD ₹100 flow instead of <GetNoticedFaster/>. Also, once a seeker becomes eligible, the Matches tab hides the card instead of flipping it to the promoted/active state.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec requires <GetNoticedFaster referralCode={done.referral} onUnlocked={..}/> to render in chat-done-panel for seekers. Code instead renders the OLD ₹100 visibility-offer (data-testid=visibility-offer) containing 'Pay ₹100 & register' (chat-pay-register-btn), the old chat-share-section with 'Simply Share for Free — Share & Visibility' heading, share-whatsapp-btn, referral-link filled with done.link, and mentions ₹100 + '10 contacts' target. get-noticed-faster / gnf-* testids DO NOT exist in ChatFlow.

After referral auto-unlock (2 group shares) or ₹499 pay, the Matches tab does NOT show the 'get-noticed-active' promoted card with the 'companies your profile has been shared with' list. Because Matches.jsx guards with `!eligible && <GetNoticedFaster/>`, the card unmounts once eligible=true and only the old 'Company names & contacts are unlocked' eligible-banner is shown. Spec: 'flip the card to the promoted/active state (data-testid=get-noticed-active) listing companies (data-testid=promoted-company)'.

Card 04 'Match & unlock' still reads: 'Companies unlock a full CV for ₹49. Seafarers unlock company contacts free by sharing — or a one-time ₹100.' Spec says the old ₹100 should be gone everywhere on seafarer-facing pages.

Dead code with '₹100 / Pay ₹100 & register / share-section / registration-section' remains in the file (~lines 100-171) even though it's no longer rendered (line 316 now uses <GetNoticedFaster/>). It also still mentions '10 contacts' (old target). Recommend removing dead code to avoid regressions and misleading testids.

Race error 'Cannot read properties of null (reading ranks)' if user taps role-seeker-btn before /api/config finishes loading. Should render the role picker only when cfg is loaded, or add a null guard inside buildSeekerSteps/buildProviderSteps.

integration_issues.issue: Auto-unlock backend call succeeds and toast 'Unlocked! Your profile is now promoted 🎉' appears after the 2nd Share-to-group click, but the UI does not display the promoted/active state on Matches — the card disappears entirely (see UI bug above).

critical_code_review_comments: ChatFlow.jsx: 583 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold and mixes chat state, mobile OTP, CV upload, summary generation and the (now-obsolete) visibility offer. Split the done-panel into its own component (already have GetNoticedFaster ready) and extract mobile+OTP into a hook.

GetNoticedFaster.jsx window.open('https://wa.me/?text=...') is not testable in headless envs — good that it's non-blocking; consider making the share opener a prop for easier stubbing.

Dashboard.jsx boost() has no confirmation modal — clicking 'Get Noticed Faster · ₹499' immediately posts /get-noticed/pay with no explicit consent step. Acceptable for demo/mock but should be gated by a confirmation UI in production.

rca of the issue: Root cause for missing get-noticed-faster in chat done-panel: ChatFlow.jsx was never updated to import/use the new GetNoticedFaster component. The inline OLD visibility-offer JSX (₹100 registration + old share section) is still hard-coded in renderInput() when `done` is truthy. Fix: `import { GetNoticedFaster } from '@/components/GetNoticedFaster'` and replace the visibility-offer block with <GetNoticedFaster referralCode={done.referral} onUnlocked={()=>navigate('/dashboard')} />; also ensure the /profile/submit response returns `referral` (or parse it from done.link). Root cause for Matches not showing active state after unlock: Matches.jsx line 316 `{!eligible && <GetNoticedFaster/>}` unmounts the component the moment eligibility flips, so the internal `eligible ? active-view : share-view` render inside GetNoticedFaster never gets to show its active view. Fix: change to `{!boosted && <GetNoticedFaster/>}` (or drop the guard entirely and let the component decide) so the promoted/active state renders after unlock.
